items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: the one that I took overseas, Fran Galbert, Willie Brown, Bud Johnson, Huey Long and John Brown on bass, Jimmy Bryan on piano.

ctx.x: Well, that was the greatest band that I ever had.

ctx.s: WHAT DO YOU THINK ABOUT THE MUSIC.

ctx.x: Well musically, I would say, I've had just two or three of them that were comparable to each other. But the one that I took overseas, Fran Galbert, Willie Brown, Bud Johnson, Huey Long and John Brown on bass, Jimmy Bryan
